assessment.diversity_evidence: The set shares one garden problem and nearly identical phrasing throughout. Most stories either water the sunflower first and later remedy the seedlings (s000028, s000035), prioritize seedlings first and then water both (s000014, s000042), or split the barrel water and defer tap repair (s000036, s000053). These are small variations on the same scarcity-and-shelter sequence, not broad plot diversity.
